text:
Alycia Baumgardner outclasses Elif Nur Turhan to become two-weight world champion, winning IBF lightweight title
Alycia Baumgardner dominated Elif Tur Nurhan to win the IBF world lightweight title; her war of words with British rival Caroline Dubois continued after the fight; Baumgardner is now a two-weight world champion after beating a hard puncher who had never lost before
Monday 9 November 2026 06:39, UK
Alycia Baumgardner, an undisputed world champion at super-featherweight, moved up to lightweight to capture the IBF world title when she shut out Elif Tur Nurhan in Texas.
Baumgardner won a unanimous decision after 10 rounds as she overcame Nurhan at College Park Center in Arlington.
The American won 100-90 on all three cards, beating a hard puncher who had never lost before.
Baumgardner hurt Turhan at times, shaking her up in the third and seventh rounds.
She poured in punches, with Nurhan feeling the weight of those attacks in the ninth round. Nurhan went the distance but, despite her punch power, could not threaten Baumgardner.
Now the IBF champion, Baumgardner looks to be on a collision course with Caroline Dubois, who fights Stephanie Han for the WBA, WBC and WBO 135lb titles on February 20, live on Sky Sports.
Baumgardner and Dubois have clashed before and the Briton was ringside in Texas. Their war of words continued after the American's latest win. "Are we going to fight?" Dubois demanded.
"You've got a champ right there in front of you," Baumgardner warned.
Ramla Ali took a contentious split-decision victory over Mikiah Kreps to win the WBO and IBF super-bantamweight titles.
Ali started sharply and knocked Kreps down with a right hook right on the chin in the third round. From then on, though, Kreps maintained real pressure on Ali and the two finished trading punches before the final bell.
Kreps won widely, 98-91, for one judge but Ali took it 96-93 and 97-92 on the other two cards.
It was an emotional victory for Ali, whose family had to flee Somalia when she was a child and settled in London. She dedicated the victory to the memory of her father who passed away earlier this year.
Skye Nicolson defended the WBC super-bantamweight title, beating Japan's Miyo Yoshida, winning a unanimous decision on a dominant display.
Nicolson took the victory 100-90, 99-91 and 98-92.
Unbeaten prospect Albina Moldazhanova knocked out former European champion Kirstie Bavington, subjecting her to heavy punishment before landing a right hook in the fourth round to finish it inside the distance. Moldazhanova has a 100 per cent knockout ratio after six pro fights.
Watch Caroline Dubois vs Stephanie Han on February 20, live on Sky Sports.
digest_he:
אלישיה באומגרדנר הפכה לאלופת עולם בשתי קטגוריות משקל לאחר שניצחה את אליף טור נורהן בטקסס וזכתה בתואר המשקל הקל של ה-IBF. באומגרדנר שלטה בקרב והשיגה ניצחון פה אחד לאחר עשרה סיבובים מול יריבה קשוחה שלא הפסידה מעולם. מיד לאחר הקרב נמשכו חילופי הדברים בינה לבין היריבה הבריטית קרוליין דובואה לקראת עימות אפשרי ביניהן.
בקרבות נוספים במסגרת האירוע, רמלה עלי זכתה באליפות העולם במשקל סופר-בנטאם של ה-WBO וה-IBF לאחר ניצחון בשלטים חלוקים על מיקיה קרפס. סקיי ניקולסון הגנה בהצלחה על תואר ה-WBC באותה קטגוריה עם ניצחון חד-משמעי על מיโย יושידה היפנית, ואילו הפרוספקט הבלתי מנוצח אלבינה מולדז'אנובה רשמה נוקאאוט מרשים בסיבוב הרביעי מול קירסטי באווינגטון.
